# Next.js Gotchas

> Known Next.js patterns that cause silent failures or hard-to-debug errors. Load all HIGH entries before writing any Next.js code.

## Entries

- ['use client' directive placement](use-client.md): Must be the very first line of the file (before imports). Cannot be in files that import server-only modules. HIGH.
- [Async Server Components](server-components.md): Server Components are async natively -- do not wrap data fetching in useEffect or useState. MEDIUM.
- [metadata export in Client Components](metadata.md): The metadata or generateMetadata export only works in Server Components. Exporting it from a Client Component silently has no effect. HIGH.
- [BullMQ + separate ioredis causes type conflicts](bullmq-ioredis-conflict.md): Installing ioredis alongside bullmq causes TS type conflicts. Use BullMQ's built-in connection config instead. HIGH.
- [Biome cannot parse Tailwind CSS v4 syntax](biome-tailwind-css-parse.md): Biome 2.x fails on @theme inline, @custom-variant, @apply. Exclude *.css files from Biome entirely. HIGH.
- [Biome 2.x removed organizeImports key](biome-v2-organize-imports.md): Top-level organizeImports config causes Biome 2.x to reject the entire config. MEDIUM.
- [serverExternalPackages not experimental](server-external-packages.md): Renamed from experimental.serverComponentsExternalPackages in Next.js 15. Old name silently fails. HIGH.
- [PostHog server SDK must flush immediately](posthog-server-flush.md): Set flushAt: 1, flushInterval: 0 in posthog-node for Next.js server functions. Events are lost otherwise. HIGH.
- [Server actions turn thrown errors into generic 500s](server-action-throws.md): Next.js intercepts thrown errors in server actions and returns opaque 500 responses. Use discriminated return types or return empty with logging instead. MEDIUM.
- [Silent empty returns from server actions hide auth failures](server-action-silent-auth-failure.md): Returning [] when auth fails is indistinguishable from "no data" on the client. Always add console.warn for auth failures in server actions. MEDIUM.
- [Standalone mode on Windows requires Developer Mode for symlinks](standalone-windows-symlink.md): output: "standalone" fails with EPERM symlink error on Windows without Developer Mode. Use `next start` from project root for local deployments. HIGH.
- [Next.js dev mode ignores PORT env var](dev-ignores-port-env.md): PORT and HOSTNAME in .env are ignored by next dev and next start. Use -p and -H CLI flags instead. MEDIUM.
- [Stripe webhook signature verification needs the raw body](stripe-webhook-raw-body.md): Use request.text() not request.json() before constructEvent. Reserialized JSON breaks the HMAC. HIGH.
- [Stripe Connect Platform OAuth requires a single registered redirect URI](stripe-connect-single-redirect-uri.md): Per-tenant path segments cannot be registered. Use a single fixed callback path and encode tenant ID in the OAuth state parameter. HIGH.
- [Non-variable Google fonts loaded via next/font/google require an explicit weight](font-weight-required.md): Variable fonts may omit weight; static fonts must pass an explicit weight the font actually ships. Omitting it fails next build with "Missing weight"; a wrong value fails with "Unknown weight". HIGH.
- [next/font CSS variable name must match the loader's variable option](font-variable-name-match.md): A var(--font-x) reference in globals.css or a Tailwind @theme block silently falls back to a system font if the next/font loader's variable: name differs. No build error. MEDIUM.
- [base-ui Menu.GroupLabel crashes the whole page when used outside a Menu.Group](base-ui-grouplabel-needs-group.md): DropdownMenuLabel maps to Menu.GroupLabel, which throws (prod-minified to "Base UI error #31") if not inside a group; in a layout subtree the throw bubbles to the root error.tsx and blanks the page with the URL unchanged. HIGH.
- [eslint-config-next 16 + ESLint 10 crash via eslint-plugin-react](eslint-config-next-eslint-10-crash.md): Under ESLint 10 the eslint-plugin-react bundled by eslint-config-next 16 throws "getFilename is not a function" and kills the whole lint run; Next 16 does not run ESLint at build, so the broken linter (and any new rules) goes unnoticed. Pin eslint to ^9.x. HIGH.
- [ESLint flat config: do not re-register a plugin eslint-config-next already provides](eslint-flat-config-plugin-redefine.md): Re-declaring a plugin (jsx-a11y, react, @typescript-eslint, import) that eslint-config-next already registers throws "Cannot redefine plugin"; to enable extra rules from a bundled plugin, only set rule severities. MEDIUM.
- [App-router catch-all only handles the verbs it exports](catch-all-verb-exports.md): A [...path] route.ts serves only its exported methods; PUT/PATCH/DELETE to sub-paths 404 when only GET/POST are exported. Add the verb or model the call as GET/POST. MEDIUM.
- [App Router route handler proxying SSE must stream the body, not JSON-decode it](sse-stream-passthrough.md): A BFF proxy that does await res.json() buffers the upstream and breaks Server-Sent Events; pipe upstream.body into new Response() with text/event-stream + no-transform + X-Accel-Buffering: no. HIGH.
- [The aborted-flag cleanup pattern does not cancel in-flight fetches](aborted-flag-not-cancellation.md): let aborted = false only blocks setState; the HTTP request still completes. Pass an AbortController signal to fetch and abort in cleanup, swallowing only AbortError. MEDIUM.
- [Module-level singletons are NOT shared between a Next.js custom server and Next API routes](custom-server-module-singletons.md): A module-level Map/cache/emitter imported by both the custom server and a Next route handler is duplicated across two webpack runtimes, so cross-runtime in-memory invalidation silently no-ops; coordinate via the DB or an external store, or re-validate per request with a version stamp. HIGH.
- [Next.js standalone server binds to process.env.HOSTNAME, breaking container health probes](standalone-hostname-binding.md): node server.js binds to $HOSTNAME, which a container/Kubernetes runtime sets to the pod name; external ingress works (200 via pod IP) but internal health probes can't connect, causing a restart loop. Set ENV HOSTNAME="0.0.0.0" in the runner stage. HIGH.
